title: Atomic Control Workbench
purpose: offline clickable control surface for generating atomic UI automation plans without executing them

planKinds.label: Atomic Gate
planKinds.description: full reversible atomic pipeline plan; still offline until manually executed

planKinds.label: Dynamic Coverage
planKinds.description: read-only native dynamic boundary coverage plan; no apply, restore, click, drag, or launch

loadModes.label: Carrier
loadModes.description: structural carrier template, zero visual assets, default safe audit mode

loadModes.label: Framework
loadModes.description: marker-only restore-safe mode for native boundary diagnosis

loadModes.label: Control
loadModes.description: in-window atomic command workbench only; zero visual assets and one-shot apply only

loadModes.label: Visual
loadModes.description: full visual theme payload; use only after carrier and framework gates pass

toggles.label: Launch if missing
toggles.risk: may open Codex only when it is not already running; never restarts a running non-CDP app

toggles.label: Interact
toggles.risk: requires explicit allow indexes or derived allowlist

toggles.label: Stateful controls
toggles.risk: allows project/sidebar/top-toolbar/popover candidates only after review

toggles.label: Auto allowlist
toggles.risk: derives indexes from dry-run report while hard-denying destructive and high-memory surfaces

toggles.label: Verify local control clicks
toggles.risk: clicks only the theme-owned control workbench mode and toggle controls after control-only read-only verification

toggles.label: Drag
toggles.risk: never enables high-memory image resize; remains false by default

invariants: dry-run clickable inventory before interactive pass
explicit allow indexes or derived allowlist before interaction
